name: Glacial Plasma
body:
School evocation [cold, fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 7

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 20-ft.-radius burst, see text
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause an explosion of polar ice followed by burning plasma to erupt from the ground in an area. Creatures and objects within the radius of the explosion take 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 20d6). Half of the damage dealt is cold damage, the other half is fire damage. Additionally, any creature within 5 feet of the radius takes 1 damage per dice rolled within the radius, split between cold and fire damage. This spell must be cast on the ground and leaves a half-sphere crater where it originates.
